checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_xml_valid_xml_document
checkers.description: The given file to check must be a valid XML document.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_xml_root_tag_is_openscenario
checkers.description: The root element of a valid XML document must be OpenSCENARIO.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_xml_fileheader_is_present
checkers.description: Below the root element a tag with FileHeader must be defined.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_xml_version_is_defined
checkers.description: The FileHeader tag must have the attributes revMajor and revMinor and of type unsignedShort.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_xml_valid_schema
checkers.description: Input xml file must be valid according to the schema.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_reference_control_resolvable_signal_id_in_traffic_signal_state_action
checkers.description: TrafficSignalStateAction:name -> Signal ID must exist within the given road network.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_reference_control_resolvable_traffic_signal_controller_by_traffic_signal_controller_ref
checkers.description: The trafficSignalController according to the trafficSignalControllerRef property must exist within the scenarios RoadNetwork definition.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_reference_control_valid_actor_reference_in_private_actions
checkers.description: In a ManeuverGroup, if the defined action is a private action an actor must be defined.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_reference_control_resolvable_entity_references
checkers.description: A named reference in the EntityRef must be resolvable.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_reference_control_resolvable_variable_reference
checkers.description: The VariableDeclaration according to the variableRef property must exist within the ScenarioDefinition.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_reference_control_resolvable_storyboard_element_reference
checkers.description: The attribute storyboardElementRef shall point to an existing element of the corresponding type and shall be uniquely resolvable.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_reference_control_unique_element_names_on_same_level
checkers.description: Element names at each level shall be unique at that level.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_parameters_valid_parameter_declaration_in_catalogs
checkers.description: All parameters used within a catalog shall be declared within their ParameterDeclaration in the same catalog, which sets a default value for each parameter.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_data_type_allowed_operators
checkers.description: Expressions in OpenSCENARIO must only use the allowed operands.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_data_type_non_negative_transition_time_in_light_state_action
checkers.description: Expressions in OpenSCENARIO must only use the allowed operands.

checkers.name: check_asam_xosc_positive_duration_in_phase
checkers.description: Expressions in OpenSCENARIO must only use the allowed operands.
